projects.title: Vocably
projects.description: Vocably is a web platform for learning vocabulary in any language through short, focused mini-games. Instead of static flashcards, each word moves through its own growth cycle — seed, sprout, bloom — as you practice it in different formats: flip cards, multiple choice, typing, and matching pairs. Every word you add carries its translation and an example sentence, and a spaced-repetition engine decides when it's due for review, so nothing gets forgotten and nothing wastes your time. Track your progress language by language, keep your daily streak alive, and watch your personal vocabulary garden grow.
